name: STREAM_ABI_SCOPED_POLICY_REFERENCE_V2
normalization: Payload publication.observation.expectedSourcesHash and receipt.observation recordHash,recordChainHash,payloadHash,payloadBytes,recordedAt are zero; sourcesHash remains populated. Record hash instead binds original expectedSourcesHash and completed payload/timestamp fields.
